observations.dwarf_cannon: The cannon unlock arrives when Lawgof receives the notes. Nulodion gives the ammo mould earlier.
observations.tower_of_life: The builders’ outfit and three machine repairs precede the basement visit. Completion enables Creature Creation.

observatory_quest.constellation_rewards: Variable XP and items are excluded from the route.

observations.the_dig_site: The Dig Site supplies the completion flag for Bone Voyage and the specimen-cleaning unlock. Individual museum specimen exhibits and claims remain under museum review.
observations.the_corsair_curse: Quest passage carries the player to Corsair Cove. Completion unlocks the bank and return ferry and adds the build 242 Firemaking reward.
observations.the_grand_tree: The quest escape glider precedes regular service. Grand Tree completion enables regular glider routes and departure from the Stronghold spirit tree when the Tree Gnome Village network is available. Femi can grant free re-entry for an earlier favor.
observations.merlins_crystal: The Lady’s bread trial gives Excalibur before the ritual. Using the sword on the crystal can be done from inventory. The separate Minas claim remains in museum review.
observations.holy_grail: Entrana rejects Excalibur, so the route can bank it before the church and recover it before crossing to the Titan. Attack level 20 applies at the Titan’s finishing blow. The second whistle goes to Percival. Percival opens B.J.R. during the quest, which is earlier than the completion gate in the pinned transport table.

pending_reviews: Check exact timings, consumable use, combat budgets and access routes against build 242 gameplay.
Review post-quest specimen cleaning and the Merlin’s Crystal report and claims with the museum catalog.
Add glider destinations gated by later quests alongside those quests.
